title: Anatomy of a Drink: Garibaldi
ldInstructionsRaw: Place 2 ice cubes in the glass and add the Campari. Juice the orange, add a little of the juice to the glass, and stir to combine. Add another ice cube and the remainder of the orange juice.
Tip: If you don’t have an electric juicer, you can still create fluffy OJ by aerating the fresh juice in a blender without ice or by frothing with a handheld milk frother.
